_note: Boundary text that replaces the secretariat's (parliament.gov.bd boundaryDetails, which still reads as the 2023 delimitation) for seats the Election Commission redrew for the 13th parliament in its gazette of 11 December 2025, and for two seats whose text names the wrong city corporation (Dhaka-11 and -12 hold Dhaka North wards). scripts/sync.mjs applies these by seat slug. Written from Prothom Alo's and bdnews24's reports of the final list (4–5 September 2025); the other changed seats, and the corrections gazetted on 24 December 2025 and 15 January 2026, await the gazette itself, whose PDF carries no readable text.
